title: Cotton Napkin 20x20", Red White and Blue Star Check, Set of 6
text: Cotton Napkin 20x20", Red White and Blue Star Check, Set of 6. we are not crazy about these at all, the front looks fabulous but the back is all stitching, I can just see them getting all mangled in the wash and only being able to use one side of the napkin is a downer.

product_metadata.title: DII Patriotic 4th of July Stars and Check Summer Tabletop Collection, Tablecloth, 60x84, Red, White, and Blue
features: CREATE A BEAUTIFUL TABLE SETTING - Our Americana tablecloth measures 60x84” in size, appropriate for a table that can seat 6-8 people; beautiful on its own or layer it with other items in this collection
EASY CARE - Made of 100% cotton, our summer tablecloth has a 1" hem; machine washable, gentle cycle, tumble dry low; low iron if needed
ADDS A FINISHING TOUCH - Our patriotic tablecloth is a bright backdrop for celebrating the Fourth of July or any lively summer gathering; this tablecloth adds a touch of patriotic flair to any table
ENHANCE YOUR HOME - Line your 4th of July feast with our matching napkins and table runner to create the perfect place setting; adds a fun accent to outdoor picnics or any meal

FOR MORE DÉCOR - DII offers delightful home products including cloth napkins, napkin rings, cloth tablecloths, table runners, placemats and home décor; click the DII link at the top of the page to explore our collections or search "DII Tabletop"
description: DII offers a full collection of trend-based designs for all seasons. Incorporating the hottest colors and themes, DII brings you a fresh, innovative line of kitchen products, tabletop accessories, gifts, and home decor for every season, every holiday, and everyone.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash colors separately • Cold water • Gentle cycle • Tumble dry low • Low iron
